description: 1 x Contorted Willow (applicants ref. T1) - Approximately 6.00m: Reduce back to previous and most recent reduction points whilst preserving 50% of fine branch structure (shortened if structurally required).  Remove dead wood throughout crown. Remove diseased branches.Crown lift by up to approximately 0.50m.  General maintenance.1 x  Beech (applicants ref. T2) - Approximately 2.50m-3.00m:  Lightly trim by up to approximately 1.00m. Remove dead wood.  General maintenance.1 x Cherry (applicants ref. T3) - Approximately 6.00m:  Reduce back to previous and most recent reduction points up to approximately 1.20m. Remove dead wood.  Thin crown density by 15%-20%.  General maintenance.1 x Hawthorn (applicants ref. T4) - Approximately 5.00m: (on boundary with woods):  Trim back ivy and where appropriate, over extended lateral branches by up to 1.00m. Control encroachment. General maintenance.1 x Small Prunus Spinosa (applicants ref. T5) - Approximately 5.00m: Tip prune lateral and sub lateral branches overhanging the drive by approximately 0.25m. To control encroachment.
application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
